headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 28, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins fell short in Toronto, dropping a 1-2 decision to the Blue Jays. Kazuma Okamoto led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Eury Pérez pitched 4.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and no earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Enrique Hernández has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Nolan Schanuel is also on the 10-day injured list with left ankle inflammation, while Gavin Lux is out with a right shoulder impingement. José Berríos is on the 60-day injured list with a right elbow stress fracture, and Alejandro Kirk has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left thumb fracture.

The Detroit Tigers made a trade on May 27, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold. The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, and the Philadelphia Phillies traded right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker to the Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for outfielder Rece Hinds.

top_news.title: **Marlins Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, unable to overcome a strong performance from the home team. Kazuma Okamoto led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Eury Pérez pitched 4.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI, while Gavin Williams earned the win for the Guardians with 7 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Milwaukee**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals lost to the Milwaukee Brewers 2-1, with Bryan Torres leading the Cardinals' offense with 1 hit and 1 RBI. Dustin May pitched 7 strong innings for the Brewers, striking out 9 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Athletics 9-1**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Oakland Athletics, securing a 9-1 victory. Logan Gilbert led the way for the Mariners, pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Place Enrique Hernández on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers first baseman Enrique Hernández has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The injury occurred on May 27, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays. In exchange, the Tigers traded right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Blue Jays.
